posts.title: The Magnolia House is officially open
posts.standfirst: A grand opening and ribbon cutting for the newest space on the estate: a white colonial house joined to a glass conservatory, with the valley on every side.
posts.body:
The Valley Venues opened the doors of the Magnolia House with a grand opening and ribbon cutting, welcoming friends, family and the community to see the newest space on the estate for the first time.

The welcome

Kobi Cummings, co-owner and artistic director, welcomed guests before the ribbon cutting.

It could not mean more to me, more to my family, that you guys are here today. This space has meant the world to us. We love bringing people together… and making beautiful spaces.

The space

The Magnolia House pairs a classic white colonial home with a soaring glass conservatory, so a ceremony or a dinner happens in natural light with the valley on every side. Inside there are crystal chandeliers, an open balcony and staircase, and room for long tables and lounges; upstairs, a separate room with a chandelier of its own.

Outside, a wide white terrace with a round bar, umbrellas and lounge seating looks out over the mountains, and a brick-walled patio sits below it.

The details

For the opening the rooms were styled in sage green and ivory: tufted sofas, white chiavari chairs, potted magnolia trees, and white hydrangea centerpieces with amaranthus hanging from them. There was a guitarist, passed bites and cocktails, and a welcome sign at the door that read, simply, Welcome to the Magnolia House at The Valley Venues.

Thank you

To everyone who came and celebrated with us, and to Barlow Film Co. for filming the day. To see the Magnolia House for yourself, walk through it here or download the wedding pamphlet.
